## mourner-d17 — bearer <redacted> to Jamal
> YOU PICK [agency:ask_field] 
YOU: "Teach me something from the wild."
NPC: "There's more, but that's for another fire."

> YOU PICK [ans:q_useful:a_hunger] 
YOU: "How to be hungry and keep going anyway."
NPC: "Okay, okay — The fundamental skill. Everything else is decoration."

> YOU PICK [invite_party] 
YOU: "Want to come with me?"
NPC: "Someone should watch your back. Might as well be me."

> YOU PICK [alive:event:mourning] 
YOU: "What’s going on out there?"
NPC: "Cheryl is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:want] 
YOU: "About the most useful thing you've learned — we never finished."
NPC: "Huh. I wouldn't have guessed that about you."

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:lately] 
YOU: "About what's been happening — we never finished."
NPC: "I memorize the stars. It doesn't bring anyone back. It just keeps my hands from shaking."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "The fire feels smaller without Cheryl. The rest of us will have to be bigger."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
NPC: "I memorize the stars for Cheryl, now. Feels right. Feels like the least I can do."
NPC: "Alright — I should get back to it."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
(conversation ended by the engine)

### FULL TRANSCRIPT
NPC: "About the most useful thing you've learned — What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here? Anyway."
YOU: "Teach me something from the wild."
NPC: "There's more, but that's for another fire."
YOU: "How to be hungry and keep going anyway."
NPC: "Okay, okay — The fundamental skill. Everything else is decoration."
YOU: "Want to come with me?"
NPC: "Someone should watch your back. Might as well be me."
YOU: "What’s going on out there?"
NPC: "Cheryl is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
YOU: "About the most useful thing you've learned — we never finished."
NPC: "Huh. I wouldn't have guessed that about you."
YOU: "About what's been happening — we never finished."
NPC: "I memorize the stars. It doesn't bring anyone back. It just keeps my hands from shaking."
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "The fire feels smaller without Cheryl. The rest of us will have to be bigger."
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "I memorize the stars for Cheryl, now. Feels right. Feels like the least I can do."
NPC: "Alright — I should get back to it."
YOU: "Tell me more."
NPC: "That's... pretty much all of it, honestly."
NPC: "Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
NPC: "This was good." They mean it.
